facts.text_en: Oyu Tolgoi produced 152 thousand tonnes of copper to 30 June 2025 and is expected to average about 500 thousand tonnes a year from 2028 to 2036.
facts.text_es: Oyu Tolgoi produjo 152 mil toneladas de cobre al 30 de junio de 2025 y se espera que promedie unas 500 mil toneladas al ano entre 2028 y 2036.
